common: Rattles in your bag all day, then sprays the ceiling the moment you crack it open.
Turns a lazy Sunday into a twitching eyelid and a 3 a.m. urge to alphabetise the spice rack.
lore.uncommon: Its heartbeat is audible through the aluminium, and it speeds up whenever someone yawns.
lore.rare: Night-shift workers leave it offerings of loose change. In return, the vending machine never jams on their floor.
lore.epic: One sip and you will not blink for a week. It feeds on the sleep you were meant to have.
lore.legendary: The first sunrise happened because it kept the sky awake. It is still deciding whether night deserves to return.
